# Rajeshwar Debbarma

Rajeshwar Debbarma is a Tiprasa Indian politician from Tripura and a leader from the Tipra Motha Party (TMP). He was a Member of the Tripura Legislative Assembly from 2003 to 2008 after winning the election from the Takarjala Assembly Constituency in 2003 as a candidate of Indigenous Nationalist Party of Twipra. As of 2025, Debbarma is appointed as one of the senior spokesperson of TMP.
Political career
Rajeshwar Debbarma started his political career from the Indigenous Nationalist Party of Twipra (INPT) in the early 2000s. He also elected as Member of Legislative Assembly from Takarjala Constituency.
Later, Rajeshwar joined Congress after repeated defeat of INPT in the subsequent elections. He joined the Bharatiya Janata Party after it came to power in 2018.
However, Rajeshwar quitted BJP in 2019 as a protest against the controversial Citizenship (Amendment) Act, 2019.
Rajeshwar joined TIPRA as having worked with its founder Pradyot Bikram Manikya Deb Barma over the years. He was appointed as political secretary and has been one of the top advisor in the party.
